title: Prevention Habits of Medical Doctors
summary:
Preventive practices among physicians remain insufficiently studied, particularly in situations for which recommendations are limited or unavailable.

The PREVMED study aims to describe physicians' preventive practices and to investigate the sociodemographic, occupational, and lifestyle factors that may influence these practices.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Physician or medical resident volunteering to participate in the study.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Person not willing to participate in the study.
